headline: Approved changing the Sons of Italy Lodge 902 license from club to restaurant at 459 Merrimack Street.
summary: Larry Giordano, of 76 Bonanno Court, Methuen, asked for the change. He said the lodge serves food at one set Thursday night event and hosts many other functions. He said hours will not change.
decisions: Approved changing the Sons of Italy Lodge 902 license at 459 Merrimack Street from club to restaurant; all members present voted in favor.

decision_evidence.quote: Commissioner Fisher motioned to accept and approve the Change of License type from club to restaurant for the Sons of Italy Lodge 902 at 459 Merrimack Street. Commissioner Melendez seconded. All in favor.

decision_titles: Change of license from club to restaurant, 459 Merrimack Street

MEETING MINUTES 
 
METHUEN LICENSING BOARD 
SEARLES BUILDING, 41 PLEASANT STREET 
SECOND FLOOR CONFERENCE ROOM #208  
 
Chairman Chase called the meeting to order. Pledge of Allegiance. 
 
Meeting of the Methuen Licensing Board on October 14, 2026, 41 Pleasant Street called to order by Chairman 
Chase. Members present were Chairman Chase, Commissioner Fisher and Commissioner Melendez, 
Commissioner Camargo, absent. 
 
Approval of the agenda for October 14, 2026. Commissioner Fisher motioned to approve the agenda for 
October 14, 2026. Commissioner Melendez seconded. All in favor. 
  
Approval of minutes from September 9, 2026, licensing meeting. Commissioner Fisher motioned to approve the 
minutes from September 9, 2026, licensing meeting. Commissioner Melendez seconded. All in favor.  
 
NEW BUSINESS 
 
An application has been submitted for a Change of License type from the Sons of Italy Lodge 902 at 459 
Merrimack Street. Larry Giordano, 76 Bonanno Court, Methuen MA came forward.  Mr. Giordano 
stated that they had the wrong license – and want it changed from a club to a restaurant license. He 
stated they only have one set food function on Thursday nights where food will be served. He also stated 
they do a lot of other functions, hence the need to change to a restaurant license. Chairman Chase asked 
if there would be any change of hours and Mr. Giordano stated no.   
 
Commissioner Fisher motioned to accept and approve the Change of License type from club to 
restaurant for the Sons of Italy Lodge 902 at 459 Merrimack Street.  Commissioner Melendez seconded. 
All in favor.  
 
 
Next meeting will be November 10, 2026. 
Respectfully Submitted by Beth Rizzo, Licensing Clerk
